descriptionChirho: A wheeled vehicle used for transporting goods, people, or offerings, including the carts sent by Pharaoh (Gen 45-46), the new cart for the ark (1 Sam 6, 2 Sam 6), and military supply wagons.
The cart or its wheel used as an agricultural threshing implement, rolled over grain to separate kernels from husks (Isa 28:27-28).
